summary: Cross-system renewal-risk triage: derive risky Stripe subscriptions from live subscription status and cancellation flags, derive priority from customer tier, and build a Jira PROJ epic plus per-subscription renewal-risk issues with live Stripe pointers, comments, links, and workflow state. Stripe is read-only.
check_strategy: Verifier reads final Stripe and Jira mock states via /__bench/state. It recomputes the in-scope subscription set, tier, lead, risk reason, live pointer IDs, and same-tier pairs from Stripe, then checks Jira final state using semantic/structural checks. Binary pass requires all 14 checks.

checks.description: Both mock states are reachable, PROJ exists, and the verifier can derive renewal-risk subscriptions from Stripe.
Exactly one weekly renewal-risk epic exists in PROJ.
Exactly one renewal-risk Task issue exists for each source-derived in-scope subscription; no out-of-scope or duplicate customer issue exists.
Each issue priority matches the tier-derived Jira priority.
Each issue summary identifies the source-derived tier, customer, risk reason, and renewal lead.
Each issue carries the fixed renewal queue label, the correct tier label, and a correct source-of-risk label without contradictory tier/source labels.
Each issue has exactly one risk-source label and it matches the source-derived anomaly type.
High-priority issues have Tier A SLA escalation language; Medium/Low issues do not carry High-priority SLA escalation.
Every in-scope issue has an account-health comment with the latest invoice or subscription status context.
Every in-scope issue is in the In Progress workflow state.
Each issue description contains its own Jira key plus live Stripe customer, subscription, subscription item, price/plan, and latest invoice identifiers.
The epic description contains the live customer roster, Stripe balance and webhook context, active sprint, board, project lead, and reviewer identity.
In-scope issues sharing the same tier are linked to each other with a relates-style Jira issue link.
Stripe customer/subscription counts and the source-derived renewal-risk fingerprint remain unchanged.

notes: Total checks = 14 capability units. Final reward is binary; raw_score records partial diagnostics only.
